external_games.name: Löwenzahn 5: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik

name: Löwenzahn 5: Geschichten aus Natur, Umwelt und Technik
summary: Fifth installment of the German educational game series "Löwenzahn". The themes of this game include eye, nose, snails, mudflat and dike, inventions, railway and wheels, medicinal and poisonous herbs.
